2608.02438.title: xPress: Parallel Refinement for Diffusion Drafters in Speculative Decoding
2608.02438.paper_summary: Block-diffusion drafters like dFlash generate an entire block of draft tokens in a single forward pass, drastically reducing the overhead of multiple-token drafting in speculative decoding. The crucial final step of the single-pass discrete denoising process involves using the logit distribution at each position to sample conditionally independent tokens. The resulting draft is thus a set of per-position marginals, rather than a joint distribution: no draft token is guaranteed to depend on its predecessors. Such independently sampled marginals tend to produce sequences with tokens that are individually likely, but jointly improbable under the target model's distribution, which verifies each token conditionally. This can cause early rejection and limits acceptance length. To address this, we propose xPress as a means to restore the missing causality in diffusion drafters. xPress is a lightweight causal refiner that reconciles the whole diffusion block at once through parallel refinement, restoring and propagating causal dependencies across the draft without a token-by-token loop. On Qwen3-8B, across seven math, code, and chat benchmarks, xPress raises acceptance length by about 30% on average (up to +56%) and its end-to-end decoding throughput by about 1.3 on average (up to 1.7) compared to the original dFlash diffusion drafter.
2608.02438.paper_summary_zh: 區塊擴散草擬器如 dFlash 在單次前向傳遞中生成整個草擬令牌區塊，顯著降低了在推測解碼中多令牌草擬的開銷。單次通過的離散去噪過程的關鍵最終步驟涉及在每個位置使用邏輯分佈來有條件地抽樣獨立的令牌。因此，生成的草擬是一組每個位置的邊際分佈，而不是聯合分佈：沒有任何草擬令牌保證依賴於其前驅。這種獨立抽樣的邊際分佈往往會產生令牌在個別上可能但在目標模型的分佈下聯合上不太可能的序列，這會對每個令牌進行有條件的驗證。這可能導致早期拒絕並限制接受長度。為了解決這個問題，我們提出 xPress 作為恢復擴散草擬器中缺失因果關係的手段。xPress 是一種輕量級的因果精煉器，通過並行精煉一次性調和整個擴散區塊，恢復並傳播草擬中的因果依賴，而無需逐個令牌的循環。在 Qwen3-8B 上，經過七個數學、代碼和聊天基準測試，xPress 平均提高了約 30% 的接受長度（最高可達 +56%），並且其端到端解碼吞吐量平均提高了約 1.3（最高可達 1.7），與原始的 dFlash 擴散草擬器相比。
